result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same behaviour and options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`). I didn't run any tests or try the command itself, so the dispatch and the `-help` output are untested.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` right before `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`:** both names go to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. `-help` checks which name was typed and prints that command's usage, so `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` (noted as the older name) and `updateConfig`.
